content.text:
This guide is in English: relay it to the user in their own language.

Write confirmation plans arrive as readable text in the user’s language, with the complete plan in structuredContent. Show that text to the user exactly as received.

# Calendar (`calendar`)

7 tools available to you in this module.

Behaviour notes

- Calendars are addressed by path: calendar_list_calendars gives the paths of this user. Events are addressed by uid, and calendar_list_events gives the uids of a period.
- Every write answers with a plan first: what it would change, the etag of the object as it is now, and which invitations would go out. Nothing is written until the very same call is repeated with confirm: true, so show the plan to the user and wait for an explicit yes.
- The plan of a create, update (when the time or the guests change), move or transfer can carry warnings: a collision with another event of the target calendar, a participant who is busy or whose agenda could not be checked, and a calendar that is not shared with the participants. Each warning has a type (collision, busy, unverifiable, calendarNotShared) and a message to read to the user. They never block: tell the user and repeat the call with confirm: true only if the answer is still yes. When sharedCalendars lists calendars the participants already see and suggestedCalendar is set, offer it; when there are several, ask the user which one to use and repeat the call with that calendar. Other people's appointments are only ever reported as busy, never with their content. When an update moves an event, the event's own slot is left out of the availability check of the guests it already has (their copy of the invitation would otherwise make them busy); the collision check always leaves the event itself out. An appointment of a guest sitting entirely inside the old slot is not reported.
- Dates and times arrive as they will be stored, and are read back in the timezone of the account; a recurring event is expanded into its occurrences before it reaches the user.
- send_invitations hands the invitation to the CalDAV scheduling of the server. The plan and the result say whether the server has e-mail invitations switched on (imipEnabled); when it is off, say so to the user instead of claiming an e-mail was sent.
- A calendar owned by somebody else (a share) needs confirm_shared after asking the user, and a transfer moves the event there and removes it from here.
- A deleted event goes to the Nextcloud trash bin of the calendar; with retention at 0 the deletion is refused rather than permanent.
- The writing tools appear only when the administrator granted them to this user; a module showing reads only means the writing grants are off.


## List calendars — `calendar_list_calendars`

Reads only. Lists calendars visible to the user.

## List events — `calendar_list_events`

Reads only. Lists events in a time range (default: next 7 days).

Parameters
- `calendar` (string, optional, length 1..1024) — calendar path (optional)
- `from` (string, optional, length 10..40) — start ISO date
- `to` (string, optional, length 10..40) — end ISO date

## Create event — `calendar_create_event`

Writes: it changes something in this Nextcloud. Creates a simple event (no recurrence) in a writable calendar. Attendees are Nextcloud account IDs; call users_search first if you are not sure of someone's ID. This call may send invitations to other people. If the resource belongs to someone else, the agent MUST ask the user before sending confirm_shared: true. First returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user and wait for explicit approval; then repeat the same arguments with confirm=true, adding the etag returned in the plan when it has one.
Flagged as destructive: the client is expected to ask the user before it runs.

Parameters
- `calendar` (string, required, length 1..1024) — calendar path, as returned by calendar_list_calendars
- `summary` (string, required, length 1..255) — event title
- `start` (string, required, length 10..40) — start: YYYY-MM-DD (all-day) or ISO with Z/offset
- `end` (string, required, length 10..40) — exclusive end, in the same format as start
- `allDay` (boolean, optional, default false) — all-day event
- `timeZone` (string, optional, length 1..64) — IANA time zone, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo
- `location` (string, optional, length 0..255) — location
- `description` (string, optional, length 0..65536) — description
- `attendees` (array of string, optional, at least 1 items, at most 50 items) — Nextcloud account IDs (not emails); if you are not sure of someone's ID, call users_search first. Replaces the attendee list.
- `send_invitations` (boolean, optional, default false) — true delivers the invitation to Nextcloud scheduling; email depends on server settings and does not confirm receipt
- `confirm_shared` (boolean, optional) — set to true only after the user confirms changing a calendar that belongs to someone else
- `confirm` (boolean, optional) — Send true only after you have shown the plan of this call to the user and the user explicitly said yes. Without it nothing is changed and the answer is the plan.

Needs `confirm` (boolean, must be true) before it writes.
Needs `confirm_shared` (boolean) before it writes.

## Edit event — `calendar_update_event`

Writes: it changes something in this Nextcloud. Updates title, location, description, dates, or attendees (account IDs; call users_search first if unsure) of an event. Recurrent series dates cannot be changed. This call may send invitations to other people. - `start` (string, optional, length 10..40) — new start: YYYY-MM-DD (all-day) or ISO with Z/offset

- `allDay` (boolean, optional) — all-day event
- `timeZone` (string, optional, length 1..64) — IANA time zone, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo
- `location` (string, optional, length 0..255) — new location; empty to clear
- `description` (string, optional, length 0..65536) — new description; empty to clear
- `attendees` (array of string, optional, at least 0 items, at most 50 items) — Nextcloud account IDs (not emails); if you are not sure of someone's ID, call users_search first. Replaces the attendee list.

- `etag` (string, optional, length 1..128) — expected etag; if it differs, nothing is changed
- `confirm_shared` (boolean, optional) — set to true only after the user confirms changing a calendar that belongs to someone else
- `confirm` (boolean, optional) — Send true only after you have shown the plan of this call to the user and the user explicitly said yes. Without it nothing is changed and the answer is the plan.

content.text:
This guide is in English: relay it to the user in their own language.

Write confirmation plans arrive as readable text in the user’s language, with the complete plan in structuredContent. Show that text to the user exactly as received.

# Contacts (`contacts`)

6 tools available to you in this module.

Behaviour notes

- List address books first; your own and shared address books are exposed, plus the read-only accounts catalog when the admin allows it. Searching without an address book also covers the accounts of the instance (colleagues, with a term of at least 2 characters, following the admin user-enumeration settings); each account result has accountId, the ID to use for invitations. Use users_search to look for accounts only. Account contacts can never be created, edited or deleted.
- Search an address book to obtain contact object URIs, then read a contact before editing it. Unknown vCard properties are preserved; the preview includes every property before and after.
- Writes first show a plan without changing anything. Wait for an explicit yes, repeat with confirm=true, and acknowledge another owner with confirm_shared=true. The optional etag prevents overwriting a newer edit.
- Contact deletion is PERMANENT in Nextcloud: there is no contact trash. After confirmation, a verified full .vcf copy is saved in /MCP backups/Contacts before native CardDAV DELETE. Backup failure prevents deletion; the result gives the backup path. Import the .vcf through Contacts to recover it.
- These tools are hidden when the Contacts app is disabled. Writing grants start disabled.


## List address books — `contacts_list_addressbooks`

Reads only. List your own and shared address books plus, when the admin exposes it, the read-only accounts catalog of the instance.

## Search contacts — `contacts_search_contacts`

Reads only. Search contacts by name, email, phone or organization in one address book or, when "addressbook" is omitted, in all of them including the read-only accounts of the instance (colleagues). Account results carry accountId, the user ID to use for invitations, attendees, Deck and Talk. An empty query lists personal contacts only; accounts need a search term of at least 2 characters.

Parameters
- `addressbook` (string, optional, length 1..1024) — Address book path returned by List address books. Omit to search all of them.
- `query` (string, optional, length 0..1024) — Case-insensitive search text.
- `limit` (integer, optional, default 50, 1..200) — Maximum results (1-200).
- `offset` (integer, optional, default 0, 0..1000000) — Offset among matching results; use nextOffset to continue.

## Read contact — `contacts_read_contact`

Reads only. Read a contact including all vCard properties and its ETag. A contact of the accounts catalog returns only its public fields and accountId, without vCard or ETag.

Parameters
- `addressbook` (string, required, length 1..1024) — Address book path returned by List address books.
- `uri` (string, required, length 1..255) — Contact object URI returned by Search contacts.

## Create contact — `contacts_create_contact`

Writes: it changes something in this Nextcloud. Create a contact in a writable personal or shared address book. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.

Parameters
- `addressbook` (string, required, length 1..1024) — Address book path returned by List address books.
- `name` (string, required, length 1..1024) — Contact name. Omit to preserve its existing value.
- `organization` (string, optional, length 0..1024) — Organization company name (first ORG component); existing departments and units are preserved.
- `title` (string, optional, length 0..1024) — Contact title. Omit to preserve its existing value.
- `note` (string, optional, length 0..65536) — Contact note. Omit to preserve its existing value.
- `url` (string, optional, length 0..1024) — Contact url. Omit to preserve its existing value.
- `emails` (array of string, optional, at most 50 items) — Replace the emails in order; existing parameters are preserved. Omit to keep all values, [] to clear them.
- `phones` (array of string, optional, at most 50 items) — Replace the phones in order; existing parameters are preserved. Omit to keep all values, [] to clear them.
- `confirm_shared` (boolean, optional) — Acknowledge changing a collection owned by another person after showing the shared notice.
- `confirm` (boolean, optional) — Send true only after you have shown the plan of this call to the user and the user explicitly said yes. Without it nothing is changed and the answer is the plan.

Needs `confirm` (boolean, must be true) before it writes.
Needs `confirm_shared` (boolean) before it writes.

## Edit contact — `contacts_edit_contact`

Writes: it changes something in this Nextcloud. Edit only supplied contact fields, preserving unknown vCard properties. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.
Flagged as destructive: the client is expected to ask the user before it runs.

Parameters
- `addressbook` (string, required, length 1..1024) — Address book path returned by List address books.
- `uri` (string, required, length 1..255) — Contact object URI returned by Search contacts.
- `etag` (string, optional, length 1..128) — expected etag; if it differs, nothing is changed
- `name` (string, optional, length 1..1024) — Contact name. Omit to preserve its existing value.
- `organization` (string, optional, length 0..1024) — Organization company name (first ORG component); existing departments and units are preserved.
- `title` (string, optional, length 0..1024) — Contact title. Omit to preserve its existing value.
- `note` (string, optional, length 0..65536) — Contact note. Omit to preserve its existing value.
- `url` (string, optional, length 0..1024) — Contact url. Omit to preserve its existing value.
- `emails` (array of string, optional, at most 50 items) — Replace the emails in order; existing parameters are preserved. Omit to keep all values, [] to clear them.
- `phones` (array of string, optional, at most 50 items) — Replace the phones in order; existing parameters are preserved. Omit to keep all values, [] to clear them.
- `confirm_shared` (boolean, optional) — Acknowledge changing a collection owned by another person after showing the shared notice.
- `confirm` (boolean, optional) — Send true only after you have shown the plan of this call to the user and the user explicitly said yes. Without it nothing is changed and the answer is the plan.

Needs `confirm` (boolean, must be true) before it writes.
Needs `confirm_shared` (boolean) before it writes.

## Delete contact — `contacts_delete_contact`

Writes: it changes something in this Nextcloud. Permanently delete a contact after saving a verified vCard backup in your Files. Nextcloud has no contact trash. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.
Flagged as destructive: the client is expected to ask the user before it runs.

Parameters
- `addressbook` (string, required, length 1..1024) — Address book path returned by List address books.
- `uri` (string, required, length 1..255) — Contact object URI returned by Search contacts.
- `etag` (string, optional, length 1..128) — expected etag; if it differs, nothing is changed
- `confirm_shared` (boolean, optional) — Acknowledge changing a collection owned by another person after showing the shared notice.
- `confirm` (boolean, optional) — Send true only after you have shown the plan of this call to the user and the user explicitly said yes. Without it nothing is changed and the answer is the plan.

Needs `confirm` (boolean, must be true) before it writes.
Needs `confirm_shared` (boolean) before it writes.

content.text:
This guide is in English: relay it to the user in their own language.

Write confirmation plans arrive as readable text in the user’s language, with the complete plan in structuredContent. Show that text to the user exactly as received.

# Tasks (`tasks`)

7 tools available to you in this module.

Behaviour notes

- Task calendars support VTODO. These tools use core CalDAV and work even without the Tasks app; list task calendars before addressing a task by UID.
- Undated tasks are included. Completed tasks are hidden by default in listings. Recurring tasks can be read; changing recurring tasks or tasks with participants is refused to protect their series and scheduling.
- Task categories are free text, as in the Tasks app. On create and edit, a categories list replaces all existing categories, [] clears them and omitting the field preserves them. tasks_list_tasks can filter by one category, ignoring case.
- Private and confidential tasks in shared calendars are hidden. Writable shares require confirm_shared=true after showing the owner notice.
- Every write starts with a before/after plan. Wait for explicit approval before confirm=true; the optional etag checks for concurrent edits. Writing grants start disabled.
- Deletion uses the native calendar trash and is refused when calendar retention is zero. The result confirms recovery through the calendar trash.


## List task calendars — `tasks_list_calendars`

Reads only. List your own and shared calendars supporting tasks (VTODO).

## List tasks — `tasks_list_tasks`

Reads only. List tasks, including undated tasks, in one visible task calendar, optionally only those with a category.

Parameters
- `calendar` (string, required, length 1..1024) — VTODO calendar path from List task calendars.
- `include_completed` (boolean, optional, default false) — Include completed tasks.
- `category` (string, optional, length 1..255) — Only list tasks with this category, compared exactly but ignoring case.
- `limit` (integer, optional, default 50, 1..200) — Maximum results (1-200).
- `offset` (integer, optional, default 0, 0..1000000) — Offset among matching results; use nextOffset to continue.

## Read task — `tasks_read_task`

Reads only. Read a task by its UID in a visible task calendar.

Parameters
- `calendar` (string, required, length 1..1024) — VTODO calendar path from List task calendars.
- `uid` (string, required, length 1..255) — event UID

## Create task — `tasks_create_task`

Writes: it changes something in this Nextcloud. Create a simple task in a writable task calendar. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.

Parameters
- `calendar` (string, required, length 1..1024) — VTODO calendar path from List task calendars.
- `summary` (string, required, length 1..1024) — Task title. Omit fields to preserve their existing values.
- `description` (string, optional, length 0..65536) — Task description.
- `start` (string|null, optional) — ISO date or timestamp with offset; null clears the start.
- `due` (string|null, optional) — ISO date or timestamp with offset; null clears the due date. Must use the same date type as start.
- `priority` (integer, optional, 0..9) — iCalendar priority: 0 undefined, 1 highest, 9 lowest.
- `percentComplete` (integer, optional, 0..100) — Progress percentage. 100 completes the task; a lower value reopens it.
- `categories` (array of string, optional, at most 50 items) — Free-text task categories, as in the Tasks app: 1-255 characters each after trimming spaces. The list replaces all existing categories; [] clears them; omit to preserve them.
- `confirm_shared` (boolean, optional) — Acknowledge changing a collection owned by another person after showing the shared notice.
- `confirm` (boolean, optional) — Send true only after you have shown the plan of this call to the user and the user explicitly said yes. Without it nothing is changed and the answer is the plan.

Needs `confirm` (boolean, must be true) before it writes.
Needs `confirm_shared` (boolean) before it writes.

Writes: it changes something in this Nextcloud. Edit supplied fields of a simple task, preserving other properties. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.

## Complete task — `tasks_complete_task`

Writes: it changes something in this Nextcloud. Mark a simple task completed with 100 percent progress and a completion timestamp. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.
